proposed_fields.status: Governor-signed order dated August 6, 2026; official journal lists the padded number 2026-0494 as filed August 6, 2026, and the filed copy includes the attestation/seal and received-and-filed stamp. The order expressly states effectiveness August 6, 2026; subsequent legal force remains unverified.
proposed_fields.key_provisions: Requires data-center developers to submit energy plans addressing near- and long-term energy needs without additional costs to other utility ratepayers; directs the PSC not to allow utilities to shift data-center costs onto other ratepayers. Directs the Energy and Environment Cabinet to deny permit applications where a data center would negatively affect listed environmental resources and requires environmental-law/public-engagement compliance. Requires tax and community-engagement commitments and preserves local-community decisions. This is not described as a categorical moratorium or repeal of all statutory incentives.
proposed_fields.end_condition: No express end date identified in the complete two-page order. Later amendment, rescission, judicial developments and actual project applicability remain unverified. The subsequent KEDFA guidance is a separate administrative publication, not a substitute for this instrument.
